mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital falls.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month change < 0), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% and rising federal funds rate above 3.0% signals labor market overheating and imminent policy tightening, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or interaction signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, declining housing starts below 1800 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when HOUST < 1800, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment growth (PAYEMS increase) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0 (3-month change), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals labor market tightness that may trigger wage inflation and central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in housing starts below 1800 and industrial production below 115 signals broad economic weakness in both consumer demand and manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1800 and INDPRO < 115, or interaction signal Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recoveries, industrial production exceeding 120 signals accelerating manufacturing output and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO > 120, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
